title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, Univ. of California on 1982-05-23
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.1 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Dolby B/Maxell XLII-S90)

ai_review.summary: Top‑notch audience capture of a high‑energy show featuring smoking versions of The Other One, Shakedown Street and Ship of Fools.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the musical fire of this May 1982 performance – citing a monster The Other One, an inspired Ship of Fools, a blistering Shakedown Street and even a standout LLR with Brent’s surprise verse.  They also note that the recording preserves ambient crowd dialogue while maintaining crystal‑clear sound throughout, making it feel like you’re right in the venue.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews are 5‑star and praise both the show’s energy and the recording’s clarity; with only two detailed reviews confidence is moderate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers highlight top‑notch sound quality despite ambient crowd dialogue, indicating a clean audience capture (likely matrix‑style) with no noticeable flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe the concert as building momentum – starting strong, getting better, and ending on an even higher note.

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent adds a surprise verse on LLR, earning special mention.
